notes.title: Small visual leaderboard update
notes.content: - Updates the UI to fit better with more leaderboard entries

notes.title: Small QOL tweak
notes.content:
- When a skin is unlocked, you can now update it during a run by exiting to main menu and applying it. 
- Fixed small issue with keybinds screen

notes.title: Achievement Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed bug where you would unlock 30 min time achievement on any finish.

notes.title: Shoot For The Stars X Speedrun.com $500 Challenge
notes.content:
🏁 Speedrunners, Lock and Load

To celebrate launch, we’re hosting a $500 Speedrun Challenge on Speedrun.com!

💰 Prize Pool: $500
📅 Dates: May 22nd - May 26th
🧠 Goal: Fastest time from start to finish!

All completed runs during this timeframe will also unlock an in game skin!

🔗 Click here to join the challenge
